name: agentforeach
description: The open-source brain for personal AI agents: one agent for each of your users, serverless, so an idle agent costs only storage.
author: Mohit Garg

scripts.build:storage: npm run build --workspace @agentforeach/storage-cosmos && npm run build --workspace @agentforeach/storage-postgres
scripts.build:platform: npm run build --workspace @agentforeach/platform-azure && npm run build --workspace @agentforeach/platform-cloudflare && npm run build --workspace @agentforeach/platform-aws
scripts.test: npm test --workspace @agentforeach/storage && npm test --workspace @agentforeach/storage-cosmos && npm test --workspace @agentforeach/storage-postgres && npm test --workspace @agentforeach/platform && npm test --workspace @agentforeach/platform-azure && npm test --workspace @agentforeach/platform-cloudflare && npm test --workspace @agentforeach/platform-aws && npm test --workspace @agentforeach/deploy-aws && node --test 'scripts/lib/*.test.mjs' 'examples/web-chat/*.test.mjs' && npm test --workspace @agentforeach/gateway
scripts.test:storage: npm test --workspace @agentforeach/storage && npm test --workspace @agentforeach/storage-cosmos && npm test --workspace @agentforeach/storage-postgres
scripts.typecheck:worker: wrangler types --config deploy/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc --include-env=false deploy/cloudflare/worker-runtime.d.ts && tsc --noEmit -p deploy/cloudflare
